title: orthocarpus purpurascens var. typicus
intro: Orthocarpus purpurascens var. typicus, commonly known as Purple Needlegrass, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orobanchaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Orthocarpus purpurascens var. typicus include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant and anti-inflammatory actions, attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic acids, flavonoids, and saponins.
